not_used.tile_size: OrthoSAM tiles the image itself; see 'OrthoSAM's own tile size' under More settings.
not_used.overlap: OrthoSAM tiles the image itself; see 'Overlap of OrthoSAM's own tiles' under More settings.
not_used.confidence: OrthoSAM gives no per-grain confidence; every grain is scored 1.
not_used.dedup: OrthoSAM merges the grains of its own tiles and passes itself.

settings.label: Resample factor of the first pass
settings.help: The image is enlarged by this factor before the first pass. OrthoSAM finds grains reliably from about 30 pixels across; 2 or 3 brings finer grains above that. Higher: finer grains found; at 2 or 3 the image has 4 or 9 times as many pixels to process.

settings.label: Coarser pass for large grains
settings.help: After the first pass, OrthoSAM can look again at a smaller copy of the image, where grains larger than a tile become whole. Half: one coarser pass at half the first pass's factor; none: the first pass only, faster, large grains may be split.

authors.source: OrthoSAM large_orthosam preset: a later pass at 0.5

settings.label: Minimum grain area
settings.help: Grains smaller than this area, in pixels of the original image, are dropped. Higher: small grains and specks removed.

authors.source: OrthoSAM large_orthosam preset, expected_min_size (30, in the preset's own units)

settings.label: Prompt points per tile side
settings.help: Segment Anything is prompted on a grid of this many points per side of each tile. Higher: more small grains found; graphics memory grows with its square.

settings.label: Stability threshold
settings.help: Segment Anything keeps a mask only when its stability score reaches this value. Higher: fewer, cleaner grains; lower: more grains, some of them poor.

settings.label: OrthoSAM's own tile size
settings.help: The side of the square tiles OrthoSAM processes. Higher: more context per tile and fewer tiles, more graphics memory.

settings.label: Overlap of OrthoSAM's own tiles
settings.help: How many pixels OrthoSAM's tiles overlap. Higher: fewer grains cut where tiles meet, slower.

settings.label: Mask dilation
settings.help: Each mask is grown by this many pixels before the tiles are merged. Higher: larger outlines, neighbouring grains touch more.

fixed.label: Segment Anything model
fixed.reason: the authors' configuration uses vit_h, which needs much more graphics memory and a 2.5 GB download; this release ships vit_b only.

fixed.label: Image preprocessing
fixed.reason: OrthoSAM's optional blurring and contrast steps are off, as in its authors' preset.

fixed.label: Masks at tile edges
fixed.reason: masks touching the edge of an OrthoSAM tile are removed and recovered from the overlapping tiles, as in the authors' setup.
